feedback_driven.quote: Contrastive atomic editing links each primitive rule edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope.

persists_across_tasks.quote: Skill-State Tree Search (STS) evaluates short edit compositions and selectively retains them as executable states that can be revisited and extended.
